lead: Three values an operator writes into a `[db]` block's `path` are not paths, and a resolver treating them as one breaks SQLite.
body: `:memory:`, the empty string and any `file:` URI are SQLite's, and prefixing them with a directory names a file nothing opens; `nvs_config::db::is_relative_file` is the predicate. On Windows `/no-such/x` has `is_absolute() == false` because it names no drive, so joining it moves it to the base's drive — use `Path::has_root`, which answers the same on both platforms.
